scope_classification.label: proper-VM endpoint-actuation conformance
scope_classification.observation_dynamics: Each fixed frozen cell is independently reset; a model action never changes the next model observation, cursor, seed, or oracle-prefix context.
scope_classification.legacy_implementation_path_note: The proper_vm_stage2 filesystem directory predates this mandatory roadmap scope correction and is not a scientific stage label.

estimand: For each relative pipeline, compound click-and-drag success minus the absolute Phase-A reference on the same 320 frozen cursor-to-box geometry cells.

raw_arm_choice.reason: This is the frozen curriculum_transfer.stage2_models.A_to_B arm, where stage2_models is the source curriculum-training provenance label and not the user roadmap stage. The later 5e-5 pair is a registered sensitivity and does not silently replace it.

geometry.cell_cursor_rule: the byte-frozen absolute oracle cursor_before for every target; this preserves normalized-grid rounding rather than substituting target_center
geometry.image_rule: reuse the byte-frozen canonical PNG for each cell and require decoded VM screenshot RGB SHA-256 equality before inference

context.rule: Each fixed geometry cell receives the last three ideal action strings in its own arm grammar inside the existing user-text prefix. Model outputs never alter a later cell's cursor, image, seed, or context.
context.reason: This keeps the 320 cells exactly paired and isolates endpoint grounding/actuation. It is not a free-running closed-loop estimand.

no_leak.note: Phase-A heldout is disjoint from Phase-A train/validation. Raw curriculum-transfer train/validation is independently zero-overlap with stage1 training data, single-step eval, multistep eval, and each other for bbox, center, cursor_bbox, and image hash.

vm.pairing: each arm starts a fresh overlay from the identical qcow/snapshot; every cell and replay resets the guest app state and verifies revision, cursor, screenshot, and button-up state
vm.guest_scene: borderless full-screen Tk canvas displaying the exact canonical PNG with the OS cursor hidden; event state is independently read back from the guest

actuation.scope: model-predicted endpoint with preregistered operation adapter
actuation.click: move with the arm-native absolute/normalized/raw endpoint primitive, then pyautogui left click
actuation.drag: mouseDown at the frozen start, move with the arm-native endpoint primitive and nonzero duration, then mouseUp in the box
actuation.important_limitation: The models were trained on target endpoint actions, not a matched drag grammar. Drag therefore tests transfer of the same predicted endpoint through a fixed operation adapter; it is not evidence that the policy natively generated a drag sequence.
fail_closed: parse/schema/unit failure is a policy failure
request error, checkpoint drift, screenshot mismatch, stale guest revision, stuck button, cursor mismatch, or guest-state mismatch invalidates the complete arm
click and drag are reset-and-replayed independently from the same start state
observed guest success must equal endpoint-in-box geometry or the artifact is invalid

primary_endpoint.name: compound_click_and_drag_success
primary_endpoint.cell_success: parse_ok AND strict_schema_ok AND unit_range_ok AND endpoint_in_bbox AND guest_click_success AND guest_drag_success
primary_endpoint.global_gate: intersection-union: both relative arms must pass their one-sided 5pp noninferiority test
primary_endpoint.finite_benchmark_gate: paired success-rate difference must be greater than -0.05 for both contrasts
primary_endpoint.confirmatory_sensitivity: one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound on absolute-success/treatment-failure discordance must be below 0.05; treatment-only successes are conservatively ignored
primary_endpoint.multiplicity: No alpha split for the intersection-union test: the global null is the union of the two arm-specific noninferiority nulls.

secondary_endpoints: absolute_only and treatment_only paired discordances by target_index and distance quartile

resource_estimate.minimum_allocation: 1 H100-80GB, 32 CPU, 128GB RAM, 02:00:00, one persistent KVM VM; serve the three 35.07GB HF checkpoints serially
resource_estimate.parallel_alternative: 3x one-GPU arm jobs plus a CPU aggregator; lower wall time but not the minimum concurrent resource design

live_smoke_evidence.legacy_name_attestation: The sealed historical artifact name contains stage2 because it predates the roadmap correction. Its six low-level KVM replays support only this roadmap stage-1.5 endpoint-actuation conformance study and do not evidence roadmap stage 2 or free-running closed loop.

execution_recovery.diagnosis: Each cell creates two detached Tk/X scene processes. Teardown previously sent SIGTERM after a substring cmdline check but never waited for exit, escalated, or asserted absence. All three arms deterministically failed after 115 cells / 230 scenes with Xlib Maximum number of clients reached.
execution_recovery.hardened_teardown: Validate the guest source as an exact argv token, send SIGTERM, poll for /proc PID disappearance, use SIGKILL only after identity revalidation if needed, poll again, assert no exact-source peer remains, and refuse to start a new scene while one remains.
execution_recovery.required_stress: CPU/KVM-only replay of at least 131 cells / 262 click-or-drag scenes in one VM, with zero exact-source processes after every scene and bounded xlsclients inventories beyond the historical 115-cell boundary.
execution_recovery.fallback_only_if_stress_fails: Predeclare four fixed contiguous chunks of at most 80 unchanged cells per arm, each in a fresh VM, with fail-closed chunk manifests and exact paired reassembly.
execution_recovery.partial_policy: All three 115-row partial files are quarantined, cannot be resumed, and cannot contribute to aggregation. Only infrastructure metadata, row counts, and byte hashes were inspected; outcome rates were not inspected.

lifecycle_stress_evidence.failure_signature: Xlib.error.DisplayConnectionError: Maximum number of clients reached
lifecycle_stress_evidence.diagnosis: Every PythonController command is prefixed with a pyautogui import and therefore opens an X connection outside the tracked detached scene PID; xlsclients does not enumerate resource-only X clients. Exact scene-source teardown alone did not prove bounded X-client lifetime.

launch_gate.authorization_scope: Fresh authorization is limited to the twelve fixed roadmap-stage-1.5 recovery chunks (four disjoint 80-cell chunks for each of three frozen arms), each in a fresh VM. It does not authorize roadmap stage 2, free-running execution, reuse of any 115-row partial, or any changed estimand.

authorization_history.reason: The single environment-split recovery authorization was consumed by jobs 135610, 135611, and 135612.

Root explicitly authorized the preregistered four-chunk fallback after lifecycle stress job 135624 reproduced the X-client ceiling despite exact scene-source teardown. Authorization is exactly twelve fresh-VM chunk jobs.

launch_gate.environment_split: Pinned smoke/OSWorld host venv must import gymnasium, desktop_env, OpenAI, PIL, and runner modules before GPU startup; prime-rl venv is restricted to vLLM and readiness.
required_before_launch: CPU contract and mock-dispatch selftests pass
CPU+KVM live smoke evidence remains hash-valid
failed 131-cell lifecycle-stress evidence is hash-pinned and activates only the preregistered four-by-80 fallback
every chunk is a disjoint complete 20-episode interval in a fresh VM and strict assembly requires exact 320-cell coverage/order/no overlap
design/readiness report is reviewed and launch is explicitly authorized
